description: Shared update policy for matbind's repos. Use with {"extends": ["github>matbind/renovate-config"]}.

packageRules.description: One PR per repo per week for everything below a major.

Below a major, merge once CI is green. Renovate merges on its next run, not GitHub's native auto-merge, which merges at once when a repo has no required checks; a repo without CI never automerges (ignoreTests stays false).
Majors get their own PR, only after approval in the dashboard, and are never merged automatically.
